adult_parts.adult_focus: Running-based preparation and change of direction
adult_parts.purpose: Warm body, rehearse running mechanics, coordination and trunk/lower-limb control.

adult_parts.adult_focus: Mobility, resistance and static balance training
adult_parts.purpose: Develop strength, stability and mobility across the body.

adult_parts.adult_focus: Resistance, dynamic balance, change of direction and plyometric training

beast_mode_stages.name: Functional Stability
beast_mode_stages.definition: Athlete can hold clean positions and perform basic movement patterns with control.
beast_mode_stages.gate: Own basic position before speed, load or chaos.

beast_mode_stages.name: Maximum Stability
beast_mode_stages.definition: Athlete can maintain clean positions under perturbation, instability, fatigue or contact-like challenge.
beast_mode_stages.gate: Stay organized when stability is challenged.

beast_mode_stages.name: Strength Stabilization
beast_mode_stages.definition: Athlete can produce force while maintaining alignment and control.

beast_mode_stages.name: Maximum Strength
beast_mode_stages.definition: Athlete can produce high force without losing structure.

beast_mode_stages.name: Power
beast_mode_stages.gate: Fast force without losing Activate standards.

beast_mode_stages.name: Maximum Power
beast_mode_stages.definition: Athlete can repeatedly produce explosive outputs while preserving movement quality.

beast_mode_stages.name: Beast Mode
beast_mode_stages.definition: Repeated controlled violence with clean mechanics under fatigue, chaos, instability and contact-like demands.
beast_mode_stages.gate: High rugby power repeatedly without posture, balance, alignment or decision-making breakdown.
